repository.name: pyledger
repository.description: Lightweight Python CLI ledger and budget tracker

issues.title: Define initial ledger & category tracking specification
issues.body: Establish the core product requirements in AsciiDoc (`docs/requirements.adoc`) covering REQ-001 (decimal ledger transactions) and REQ-002 (category summaries).

issues.title: Implement core Ledger entry and category balance engine
issues.body: Implement Python ledger engine derived from #1 covering REQ-001 and REQ-002, with unit tests for deposits, expenses, and category rollups.

issues.title: Bug: Split transaction rounding loses 1 cent on odd 3-way splits
issues.body: When splitting $10.00 three ways under REQ-001, `split_amount` returns three $3.33 entries ($9.99 total) instead of allocating the remainder cent. Discovered while testing #2.

issues.title: Add monthly category budget threshold alerts
issues.body: Implement budget rules and warning alerts specified in REQ-003 (`docs/requirements.adoc`). Should flag categories exceeding 80% warning or 100% limit.

issues.title: Support multi-currency FX rates in CSV import
issues.body: Track implementation work for REQ-004 multi-currency ledger support. Waiting on FX provider selection.
